definition: [ עָלַף ] verb cover (Late Hebrew id., cover, faint ; Arabic smear , II. cover , sheath ; Assyrian elpitu , pining , exhaustion ); — Pu`al Participle feminine covered, encrusted , construct מְעֻלֶּפֶת Song 5:14 his belly if ivory encrusted with sapphires. Perfect 3 plural בָּנַיִךְ עֻלְּפוּ Isa 51:20 thy sons are enshrouded, enwrapped , i.e. their senses obscured = have swooned away ; so also Ezek 31:15 , reading 3 feminine singular עֻלָּ֑פָה for substantive עֻלְפֶּה ( Kö ii. 1, 118 ), all the trees have fainted for ( עַל ) him (so ᵐ5 ᵑ6 ᵑ9 Hi Co and others). Hithpa`el enwrap oneself, Imperfect 3 feminine singular וַתִּתְעַלָּ֑ף Gen 38:14 ( J ); = swoon away , 3 masculine singular וַיִּתְעַלָּ֑ף Jonah 4:8 3 feminine plural תִּתְעַלַּפְנָה Amos 8:13 .
